page.overview:
Who is Copper Golem?

A copper golem is a buildable passive mob that takes items from copper chests and organizes them into normal chests, and oxidizes like normal copper blocks.

Copper golems cannot spawn naturally. Instead, the player has to place a carved pumpkin or a jack o'lantern block on top of, below, or next to a copper block. On construction, the copper block turns into a copper chest, and the carved pumpkin or a jack o'lantern block turns into a copper golem, both with the same oxidation level as the copper block. Dispensers can also cause a golem to spawn by dispensing a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern onto the copper golem.

Copper golems can also be spawned by using their spawn egg or by command.

Copper golems visit up to 10 copper chests (regardless of their oxidization or waxed status) in sequence to try to take out up to 16 of the first item if the copper golem is not holding anything. If the copper chest is empty, the copper golem will idle for 7 seconds before moving on to another copper chest. When a copper golems is holding an item, it will visit up to 10 chests and trapped chests in sequence to try to place the item in it. If the chest or trapped chest already contains an identical item and there's room for another one, the golem will place the item inside.
